name: S1Client

test_list.description: The input bound includes the UTF-8 bytes of primary text, context, and the inserted separator before any RPC is sent.
Empty decision schemas fail locally without a worker connection.
Worker results must return exactly the requested question IDs.
Choice results must use the selected top label and descending scores.
Score labels derived from integer ranges count toward the aggregate schema byte limit.
Client configuration cannot exceed the worker's 262144-byte input limit.

inputs.name: transport
inputs.description: A bounded configured local named pipe or private Unix-domain socket connection to the worker.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: SDK decision input forwarded to the isolated inference process.

output_description: A kernel-side client that communicates only through the worker RPC contract, applies protocol and input bounds, and does not cache answers without model identity on the wire.
